name: Spreadsheets
summary: Download the goals as an Excel workbook or CSV files, and load changes back from a spreadsheet, with every change shown before it’s saved.

rebuild.builds: Download every goal, plan number, check-in, person and ask as one Excel workbook or a zip of CSV files in the one spreadsheet format, and load a workbook, a zip or one CSV back: every row goes through the change engine (stage 2), is shown before it is saved, and saves all at once or not at all. Tools for it on Data and Goals.
entry: The change engine (stage 2) reads every sheet of the spreadsheet format: Goals, Plan, Check-ins, People and Asks.
exit: A workbook downloaded from the rebuild and loaded straight back changes nothing: every row reads as unchanged.
A workbook with one wrong row saves nothing, and the preview names the row and the problem.
gaps: The spreadsheet format (every sheet, column and how each is read) is in docs/export-format.md, which is not in the kit yet.
No conformance rows for a download or a load yet, so nothing scores this stage; its journeys are Faro’s own eval scripts.
